personality_one_liner: A clean, native-feeling, high-trust interface focused on clarity, structured data, and readable Arabic typography for managing employee performance and bonuses.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Clear grouping of KPIs using surfaceSecondary. Arabic RTL requires right-aligned text and mirrored icons (like back button).

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use on featured KPI cards overlaying the abstract green background
dont's: Do not use on generic form fields or list items

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of company performance, recent infractions, and quick KPI entry buttons.

states.empty: Illustration of a clean desk with text 'لا توجد بيانات لهذا الشهر' and a primary CTA 'إضافة بيانات'
states.error: Readable error message with a 'إعادة المحاولة' button

screens.layout: Modular card-based layout. A featured hero card (glass over green abstract texture) for top-level stats (Total Bonus Fund). Horizontal scroll for quick team KPI metrics. Floating Action Button (FAB) for quick infraction logging.

screens.name: Employee Portal
screens.purpose: Transparency screen for the employee to view their expected bonus (دج) and logged infractions.

states.empty: Stack of coins illustration with text 'لم يتم احتساب المردودية بعد'

screens.layout: Large numeric typography for the Expected Bonus at the top. Segmented controls below to switch between 'My Performance' and 'Infraction History'. Clear progress bars for KPI achievements.

screens.name: Settings Center
screens.purpose: Advanced configuration for KPIs, job titles, and bonus calculation rules.
screens.layout: List-heavy layout. Grouped iOS-style settings rows. Labels above inputs for forms, with sticky 'حفظ' (Save) CTA at the bottom.

hero_card_background.alt: Green abstract texture for hero cards

bonus_empty_state.alt: Minimal coins stacked for bonus calculation

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure RTL (Right-to-Left) is fully implemented using I18nManager from React Native and flexbox directions (e.g., flex-row-reverse or correctly aligned start/end).
Typography: Load and use 'Cairo' for display headings and 'Tajawal' for text body using expo-font. Restrict font weights to 400/500 max.
Do NOT use any shade of Blue, Indigo, or Purple. The app strictly uses the Moss Green/Botanical palette to convey trust and financial growth.
For the Admin Dashboard, use modular cards. Place a sticky primary action button (e.g., 'Log Infraction' / 'تسجيل مخالفة') at the bottom of the screen or as a glass FAB.
Format currency properly with 'دج' (Algerian Dinar) suffix.
Any text displayed over the 'hero_card_background' must have a vertical top-to-bottom transparent-to-dark gradient scrim to guarantee WCAG contrast ratios.
